# Medical Professional Bodies

This folder catalogs professional medical organizations and societies that provide clinical guidelines, expert consultations, and quality development frameworks for Danish acute surgery. It includes international bodies whose imaging recommendations inform local diagnostic indicators, as well as national Danish societies consulted on radiological practices and partnered with steering committees to develop new clinical nutrition quality metrics. Every page preserves the original mentions and relationships linking these bodies to specific indicators and governance efforts.

## Pages

- [[american-college-of-radiology|American College of radiology]] — Provides international imaging guidelines for acute abdominal pain and suspected ileus that inform local diagnostic indicators.
- [[dansk-radiologisk-selskab|Dansk Radiologisk Selskab]] — The national Danish radiological society consulted for expert positions on imaging practices within the acute surgery database.
- [[dansk-selskab-for-klinisk-ernaering|Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring]] — Collaborates with the national steering committee to develop new evidence-based quality indicators for clinical nutrition in acute surgical care.
